Morgan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands + leadership Q&A re: the outage. RCA: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners, one-line ETAs, and the requested 2-line ops blurb. Keep replies short. :memo:

Zoe: I'll own the rollback playbook + canary verification script. ETA: 2026-03-28 10:00 UTC. Will add steps to `docs/ops/kv-rollback.md`.

Cal: I'll update the oncall runbook and add the new alert thresholds (stall_rate > 0.015 for 3m) plus a verification checklist. ETA: 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC.

Priya: I'll draft the customer note for Hosted and Dedicated tiers, plain language + RCA link. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 18:00 UTC and will tag Legal/PR.

OpsBot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-042-ACTIONS and assigned Zoe/Cal/Priya. Link: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ACTIONS.

Morgan: Leadership asked: 1) Any immediate public SLO changes? 2) Will we provision temporary Dedicated capacity? 3) Who owns the 7-day elevated regression watch?

Zoe: No SLO change today. If rollback doesn't restore baseline within 72h we'll propose a narrow guardrail.

Cal: Ops can provision a 48h Dedicated buffer for critical accounts pending manual approval; I'll prepare the approval packet once we have the list.

Priya: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day elevated watch; I'll post a short morning snapshot here each day.

Zoe: Rollback smoke commands I'll include in the playbook:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy
curl -sS http://internal-metrics/kv | jq .kv_hit_rate
```

Cal: Proposed Prometheus alert expr: `increase(kv_stall_total[3m]) / increase(kv_req_total[3m]) > 0.015`. Adding Grafana panel and playbook link.

Priya: Draft comms posted: https://redwood.company/drafts/comm-INC-2026-042. Pinged @Legal @PR.

Morgan: Two-line ops blurb for next all-hands (please copy/paste if ok):
"Rolled back a KV cache change to restore baseline performance. Tightened detection thresholds and started a 7-day elevated monitoring window with temporary Dedicated capacity options for critical customers."

Morgan: Thanks all  please paste final doc/task links here when done and I'll export the action tracker. Closing thread for new topics; append links only. :white_check_mark:
